Private Function Read(ByVal wb As Object, ByVal c As Object, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim v As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        v = c.Name
    Case 1
        v = c.Description
    Case 2
        v = c.Type
    Case 3
        v = TypeName(c.OLEDBConnection)
    Case 4
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.Connection
    Case 5
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.CommandText
    Case 6
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.CommandType
    Case 7
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.BackgroundQuery
    Case 8
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.RefreshOnFileOpen
    Case 9
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.EnableRefresh
    Case 10
        v = c.RefreshWithRefreshAll
    Case 11
        v = c.InModel
    Case 12
        v = TypeName(c.Parent)
    Case 13
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.SavePassword
    Case 14
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.MaintainConnection
    Case 15
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.RefreshPeriod
    Case 16
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.IsConnected
    Case 17
        v = TypeName(c.ODBCConnection)
    Case 18
        v = TypeName(c.ModelConnection)
    Case 19
        v = TypeName(c.TextConnection)
    Case 20
        v = TypeName(c.WorksheetDataConnection)
    Case 21
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.SourceConnectionFile
    Case 22
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.ServerCredentialsMethod
    Case 23
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.AlwaysUseConnectionFile
    Case 24
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.LocalConnection
    Case 25
        v = c.OLEDBConnection.UseLocalConnection
    Case 26
        v = TypeName(c.OLEDBConnection.Parent)
    Case 27
        v = wb.Connections(wb.Connections(1).Name).Name
    Case 28
        v = wb.Connections("CONNECTION").Name
    Case 29
        v = TypeName(wb.Connections(0))
    Case 30
        v = TypeName(wb.Connections(9))
    Case 31
        v = TypeName(wb.Connections("zz"))
    Case 32
        v = TypeName(wb.Connections.Parent)
    Case 33
        v = wb.Connections.Count
    End Select
    Read = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Read = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    s = wb.Connections.Count
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path, UpdateLinks:=0, ReadOnly:=True)
    For i = 0 To 33
        s = s & "~" & Read(wb, wb.Connections(1), i)
    Next
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = s
End Function
